title: oU1TS Academic & Social Portal
description: A centralized SPA web application designed for UITS students to share academic resources, find project partners, and connect with mentors in the tech industry.

title: Blood Donation & Urgent Alert Network
description: An emergency blood matching platform that utilizes geographical locations to connect local donors with UITS community members in critical health situations.

title: Cyber Security Resource & Lab Simulator
description: An interactive environment featuring sandboxed challenges for training students in penetration testing, threat hunting, and modern cybersecurity protocols.

title: UITS Bot & Routine Automation System
description: A utility ecosystem for student routine formatting, automatic CGPA tracking, and handwritten lecture notes storage using Telegram API integration.

title: Academic Research & Thesis Repository
description: A collaborative platform dedicated to cataloging and storing research drafts, undergraduate thesis works, and publication articles from UITS CSE.

title: Smart Academic Calendar & Room Allocator
description: A responsive planning tool built to prevent timetable conflicts and optimize class allocations across UITS campuses dynamically.
